own_solution.law: Conservation of momentum and kinetic energy gives v1f = ((m1-m2)u1 + 2m2u2)/(m1+m2). The base answer is ((3-2)6 + 2(2)(1))/5 = +2 m/s. With a block of mass q fixed to the first cart, v1f = (10+6q)/(5+q), with masses expressed in kg.
assumptions: The stated perfectly elastic, one-dimensional collision involves the first and second carts.
A fixed block moves rigidly with its cart and contributes to its colliding mass.
The specified velocities immediately before collision apply with any added block.
The earlier run leaves no block attached in the present run.
